Elements hidden via inline style="visibility:hidden" must not appear in the output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>visible</p><span style=\"visibility:hidden\">secret hidden span</span><p>also visible</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
